name: relative-time
title: RelativeTime
description: A time relative to now ("in 14 min", "2 s ago") in a <time datetime>, kept current, with the absolute time in a Tooltip and as hidden text.
usage: Use RelativeTime where how long ago or how soon matters more than the clock time: a grant's expiry, "last run" in the status line, when a connection was created. date takes a Date, an ISO string or epoch ms; timeZone sets the absolute time's zone ("UTC"). It updates itself; pass now to freeze it. tooltip={false} drops the Tooltip (and the tab stop) in long lists. For a timestamp in a data cell, show the absolute value instead.

props.name: now
props.description: Freezes now (epoch ms); otherwise the clock.

props.name: live
props.description: Keeps the text current while mounted.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale; the user's own by default.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: Time zone of the absolute time.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Absolute time in a Tooltip on hover and focus; the time is focusable.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: datetime in ISO 8601; data-slot="relative-time", data-tooltip; dotted underline when it has a tooltip.

states.name: tooltip
states.description: Has a tooltip: dotted underline in color.fg.subtle, focusable.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

accessibility: A <time> with a machine-readable datetime; screen readers read the relative text followed by the absolute time from visually hidden text, so nothing depends on the tooltip.
With a tooltip the time is in the tab order and the Tooltip opens on focus as well as hover.
Not a live region: the text updates silently (an announcing countdown would never stop). Announce an expiry with a Toast or Alert instead.
Formatting uses the browser's Intl APIs in the user's locale; nothing is downloaded.
